trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one follows on its own. No multiplayer, no DLC — single-player only.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks as the story moves on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Reach the end of Chapter 1. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the official name.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Beat the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Beat the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Beat the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Beat the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Beat the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Beat the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Push the in-game checklist to 100%. It appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and it asks for 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, all 39 illegal operations, all 8 bank vaults, and Bret's 15 target decks.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. The checklist wants 300. Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, and watch your tally under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until their conditions are met. Track them under Activities, Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; a few charge an entry fee. Track them under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race again never counts twice. Most race spots let you hire a car, and a car's Rating matters, so upgrade it at a Mod Shop. Track them under Activities, Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in Chapter 1 he texts you a fishing spot. Catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; you need a boat with a rod, and hijacking one works.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only; it starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand — seven shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so it is not missable. The final mission is Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2; the final mission is Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed. It can be done after the story, and it does not count toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by finding his wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down the labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots; a meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find them on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. Possibly missable: one Chapter 1 morning meditation at Jason's house — Lucia meditates on the balcony, so follow her and accept the optional quest — is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx flags it; Push Square lists no missables, and it is unclear whether the trophy needs that one spot, since it is not marked like the other 18. Do it when it comes up.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is unconfirmed — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% needs anyway, should cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; 100% needs 15. Cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward progress. Track them under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — hold Up to open it: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track them under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; 100% needs 70. Track them under Progress, Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape. Possible once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2; bank jobs hand out 4 stars anyway.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner without losing the wanted level. It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough — you do not have to drive them. 100% needs 200 of 277. Track them under Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet parked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They have been found at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. There are eight vaults in total and 100% needs all eight; bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Grade note: Push Square lists this as Bronze, but the starter list, Insider Gaming and sixshore all list Silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or blow a truck's back door open with a sticky bomb earlier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is fastest.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total and 100% needs all of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No reliable method has been published for this one yet. Treat any walkthrough that claims a method with suspicion, and check PowerPyx for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No reliable method has been published for this one yet. Check PowerPyx for updates.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress. Note: Push Square does not mark this one as hidden.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No reliable method has been published for this one yet. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No reliable method has been published for this one yet. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No reliable method has been published for this one yet. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle, but neither is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and contacts. It adds up across robberies; the dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes.
